category: inference endpoint, volunteer GPU network, anonymous key
reliability_note: anonymous requests are the first restricted under high load, and a job not served within the time limit times out

free_tier.stated: Text generation on volunteer GPUs with no account: the README gives API key 0000000000 for anonymous use and 'No need to register'. Anonymous requests have the lowest priority and the service 'may be restricted for anonymous users during high load'. Kudos never expire.

tooling: REST API at https://aihorde.net/api/; any client that sends the key 0000000000 for anonymous use
chaining: text jobs are served by whichever volunteer worker hosts the requested model, so the per-model queue ETA, not a quota, decides latency

limits.value: no per-key quota is published for anonymous use; anonymous requests have the lowest priority and a request that finds no resources within the time limit times out. At the read: 97 text requests queued, 30 text workers on 64 text threads, 27861 tokens generated in the past minute
per-model queue ETA across the 28 listed text models ran from 0 seconds to 516 seconds

binding_note: the queue binds: anonymous jobs wait behind jobs from accounts holding kudos, and a job not served within the time limit times out

identity_cost.detail: the API key 0000000000 needs no registration; a registered account (OAuth2 login or a pseudonymous key) gets higher priority

confidence_note: that an anonymous generation completes with the key 0000000000 is documented and not measured; the pool figures are first-party API listings read once

evidence.proved: anonymous requests have the lowest queue priority
anonymous access can be restricted under load
evidence.quote: - Service may be restricted for anonymous users during high load

evidence.proved: use is free, including anonymously, and kudos never expire
evidence.quote: anyone can use it for free, even [anonymously](https://github.com/Haidra-Org/haidra-assets/blob/main/docs/definitions.md#anonymous), and kudos never expire

evidence.proved: a request not served within the time limit times out
evidence.quote: If there are not enough resources to fulfill a request within a certain time limit, the request will time out and you will have to try again.

evidence.proved: the anonymous key can use generation with the lowest priority
evidence.quote: They can use the generation capabilities of the AI horde, but they have the lowest priority.

evidence.proved: text queue and worker counts at the read: 97 queued text requests, 30 text workers, 64 text threads
27861 tokens were generated in the past minute against 33289 queued tokens
the slowest listed text model had a queue ETA of 516 seconds; the listing holds 28 text models, counted from the response, and the fastest had an ETA of 0

notes: Image generation on the same network is a separate offer (compute/ai-horde). The text catalogue changes with whichever volunteers are online.
